def run(tau,extra=True):
    tb=[np.ones_like(t),t,np.log(t),np.sqrt(t),np.exp(-t/tau)]
    pb=[np.ones_like(P),P,P**2]
    cols=[a*b for a in tb for b in pb]
    if extra: cols+= [np.exp(-P)*np.ones_like(t)]
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)[0]
    return np.mean((y-A@c)**2)/np.var(y), c

def run(b,deg=3,pd=2):
    cols=[]
    for i in range(deg+1):
        for j in range(pd+1):
            cols.append(t**i*P**j)
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    # y*(1+bP) = A c  -> solve for c; evaluate residual in y-space
    Ab=A
    Yb=y*(1+b*P)
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(Ab,Yb,rcond=None)[0]
    pred=(A@c)/(1+b*P)
    return np.mean((y-pred)**2)/np.var(y), c

    return (params[0]+params[1]*P+params[2]*P**2+params[3]*t+params[4]*t*P
            +params[5]*lt+params[6]*P*lt+params[7]*st+params[8]*np.sqrt(P)+params[9]*e*P*np.log(P)
